blocks.text: You’re lost amongst the streets of a city you thought you knew. The blistering heat from the sun creates deep dark shadows shrouding the interiors of shops and buildings you pass in darkness.
You pass a homeless man swirling one single coin in a metal can. He leers up at you and says, “Wat ya lookin’ at, honkie tonk?” You continue down the street.
You notice a little fortune teller shop to your left. It must be new. You do not remember seeing this place before but feel drawn inside like a magnet. There is something strange about this shop.
